place.raw: Elizabeth, Essex County, New Jersey, USA

notes: LIKELY SPLIT-GENERATION DUPLICATE (research 2026-07-03): this record (b.1615 Hempstead, d.1684 Elizabeth NJ) and I182541956481 ("Richard (Richardus) Valentine (Valentyne)", b.1610 Eccles/d.1684 Hempstead NY) both feed into the same daughter, Mary Margaret Valentine, and both die in 1684 — likely one real immigrant split into two tree "generations." Independent sources (WikiTree Valentine-517, geni.com, freepages.rootsweb.com) describe a single immigrant Richard Valentine of Eccles Parish, Lancashire — one of the original 1644 Hempstead, Long Island proprietors (Townsman 1659, Overseer 1676, Constable 1679) — born c.1595, not 1610 or 1615 as either tree record has it.
